exposure: human amniotic mesenchymal stromal cells (hAMSCs) as a feeder layer
outcome: ex vivo expansion of hematopoietic stem cells (HSC) and progenitor cells
cohort: The study utilized umbilical cord blood (CB)-CD34+ cells and mesenchymal stromal cells (MSC) derived from the amniotic membrane (hAMSC) of human term placenta.
finding: Human amniotic mesenchymal stromal cells (hAMSCs) serve as a valuable alternative to bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cells (BM-MSCs) for supporting the ex vivo expansion of cord blood-HSC, colony forming unit ability, and long-term culture initiating cells ability.
